labels.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

rels.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS rel, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

substances.cypher: MATCH (s:Substance) RETURN s.name AS name, s.aliases AS aliases ORDER BY toLower(s.name)

q5_clause_by_threshold.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name:'Cái Quang Huy'})-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(k:Case)-[v:INVOLVES]->(s:Substance {name:'MDMA'}) MATCH (k)-[:CHARGED_WITH]->(:Crime)<-[:DEFINES]-(a:Article)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(cl:Clause) -[:HAS_THRESHOLD]->(t:Threshold)-[:FOR_SUBSTANCE]->(s) WHERE v.grams >= t.min_qty AND (t.max_qty IS NULL OR v.grams < t.max_qty) RETURN v.amount AS amount, v.grams AS grams, a.id AS article, cl.number AS clause, t.point AS point, t.min_qty AS min_g, t.max_qty AS max_g, cl.penalty AS penalty

rows.penalty: phạt tù 20 năm, tù chung thân hoặc tử hình

methamphetamine_to_law.cypher: MATCH (k:Case)-[:INVOLVES]->(s:Substance {name:'Methamphetamine'})<-[:FOR_SUBSTANCE]-(t:Threshold) RETURN count(DISTINCT k) AS cases, count(DISTINCT t) AS thresholds

q6_mdma_cases.cypher: MATCH (k:Case)-[r:INVOLVES]->(:Substance {name:'MDMA'}) RETURN k.name AS case, k.doc_id AS doc_id, r.amount AS amount ORDER BY doc_id
